WiseTriosRoomSage1Text:
Astounding…

SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU have arisen from their sleep…

Is the legend
coming true?
WiseTriosRoomSage2Text:
We train at the
BURNED TOWER, but

we've never heard
of a hole opening

up there before.
It must have been

deliberately made
by someone.
WiseTriosRoomSage3BlocksExitText:
TIN TOWER may be
entered by those

bearing ECRUTEAK's
GYM BADGE.

However, now that
SUICUNE, RAIKOU

and ENTEI have
arisen, I ask you

to refrain from
entering!
WiseTriosRoomSage3Text:
We, the WISE TRIO,
are the protectors

of the legendary
#MON.
SageGakuSeenText:
Legend has it that
upon the emergence

of a trainer who
has the ability to

touch the souls of
#MON, a #MON

will come forth to
put that trainer

to test at the TIN
TOWER.

The legend has
come true!

The legendary
#MON SUICUNE has arrived!

We, the WISE TRIO,
shall test your

worthiness to go
inside!
SageGakuAfterBattleText:
Ah, so it is you
who claim to have

seen SUICUNE,
ENTEI and RAIKOU while they slept?

Unbelievable!

Legend has it that
they can't be seen while they sleep…
SageMasaSeenText:
Can you be trusted
with the truth?

I must ascertain
your worthiness.
SageMasaAfterBattleText:
In the past, there
were two nine-tier towers here.

The BRASS TOWER,
which was said to

awaken #MON,
and the TIN TOWER,

where #MON were
said to rest.

The view from the
tops of the TOWERS

must have been
magnificent.

At the time, an
immense, silver-

colored #MON
was said to make

its roost atop the
BRASS TOWER.

However…

About 150 years
ago, a lightning

bolt struck one of
the TOWERS.

It was engulfed in
flames that raged for three days.

A sudden downpour
finally put out the blaze.

And that is how
the BURNED TOWER came to be.
SageKojiAfterBattleQuestionText:
You… Are you the
trainer who is

awaited by the
legendary #MON?
SageKojiAfterBattleSpeechText:
I see…

We, the WISE TRIO,
have been given 

the responsibility
of protecting the

legendary #MON.
We are to allow

passage only to
those people who

possess the power
and soul of truth.

Please, do go on
and enter the TIN TOWER ahead.

SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
SageKojiAfterBattleFinalText:
Please, do go on.

SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
